name: Sonata Software Ltd
title: Sonata Software Ltd - 532221 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Sonata's international USD revenue was flat QoQ in Q4 FY26 and down 2.1% for FY26, with utilisation at 91.8% and management guiding only to similar EBITDA, so no supply-side capacity signal and growth is still pending.

utilisation.quote: Utilization reported as this quarter is 91.8% in Q4 compared to 90% in Q3 2026.

capex.quote: Both the capex is because we had to launch a new facility in Chennai for one large BFSI customer this is like a one-time activity

triggers.label: Utilisation 90% → 91.8%
triggers.quote: Utilization improved to 91.8% up from 90% in Q3 2026.

triggers.label: AI order book 18% of total
triggers.quote: AI-led order book and now contributed to around 18% of overall order book.

triggers.label: Growth still only 'gradual' in medium term
triggers.quote: We remain cautiously optimistic and expect gradual improvement and growth over the medium term.

guidance.quote: Our endeavor will be to maintain EBITDA at a similar level.

guidance.value: back to growth trajectory this fiscal year
guidance.quote: we should be back to our growth trajectory

red_flags.label: Large deal pipeline count sharp drop
red_flags.quote: the large deal pipeline, which have disclosed the numbers, if I add up that is 11.

red_flags.label: Domestic direct billing by OEM
red_flags.quote: despite facing the headwind due to one of our OEM partners starting direct billing with some selected large customers

red_flags.label: Management change and CEO transition
red_flags.quote: Since Samir Dhir expressed his inability to extend his contract beyond the current contract period, the Board had to take a call on the succession.

evasions.quote: It is just a point of time it does not reflect anything on a pipeline now overall.
We will continue to invest. We will continue to monitor.
The exact specificity of which areas are something that we will formulate in the next couple of months
